newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude edges up in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude edges up in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: The price of North Sea Brent crude oil edged up in late U.S. paper trading late on Thursday, traders said.
A full boat of July Brent traded at $18.50 a barrel, up six cents from the IPE settlement.
A partial cargo changed hands at $18.45, up a penny.
June/July Brent traded at minus 13 cents. May/June was talked at minus 23/18 cents, and July/August at minus 12/10 cents.
Activity was light amid the UK elections, May Day celebrations, and an industry golf touranament in Houston.
